head.title: Vegan Menu Ideas Dubai | myCHEF
head.meta_description: Vegan menu ideas for Dubai events, with balanced dishes, thoughtful service and clear questions about ingredients, allergies and complete pricing.

opening_paragraph: Vegan menu ideas in Dubai can be generous, varied and full of character. Build the meal around vegetables, grains, pulses, fruit and suitable plant-based ingredients, then confirm the preparation and service required for your occasion.

new_paragraphs: Think about texture, flavour and substance across the meal. A fresh starter can lead into a grain or pulse-based main, roasted vegetables and a bright sauce, followed by a considered dessert. A sharing table can combine mezze, salads and warm dishes for variety.

A vegan menu excludes animal-derived ingredients, including meat, fish, dairy, eggs, honey and gelatin. Ask about stocks, sauces, pastry, garnishes and purchased components, since the main ingredient alone does not describe the whole dish.

Vegan dishes can still contain nuts, soy, wheat, sesame and other allergens. Shared kitchens may handle animal products and allergens. Give the culinary partner a complete dietary brief so it can explain the controls and any remaining cross-contact risk.

Vegan describes the menu, while delivery, buffet, canapés and plated dining describe how it is served. Pricing follows that service format and the agreed ingredients. Request an itemised proposal rather than assuming every vegan event uses the bespoke plated-dining rate.

Compare the complete service, including the menu, guest count, preparation, staffing, equipment, delivery and clear-down. A per-person price is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Ask which elements are fixed and which can change if your plans change.

Share allergies and other dietary requirements before confirming. The culinary partner should explain the preparation arrangements and any remaining cross-contact risk. Review the payment schedule, cancellation terms and change deadlines in your written booking.

Send the date, Dubai address, expected guest count and preferred service time, together with your menu ideas and venue details. Photos of the kitchen or service area can help the team assess what is practical.

myCHEF typically replies within 15 minutes between 9am and 11pm Dubai time. The tailored proposal follows once the requirements and availability have been reviewed. A first reply is an acknowledgement, rather than confirmation that a chef or date has been secured.
